name: Will selling my home to avoid foreclosure still affect my credit score?

mainEntity.name: Will selling my home to avoid foreclosure still affect my credit score?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selling your home before foreclosure generally has a less severe impact on your credit score than a completed foreclosure. A traditional sale will typically have no negative credit impact if your mortgage is paid off. A short sale might show as 'settled for less than full balance' or similar, which is better than a foreclosure but can still affect your credit. Understanding these practical tradeoffs is important.
acceptedAnswer.description: Selling your home typically affects your credit less than foreclosure. A short sale may show as 'settled for less,' while a traditional sale usually has no negative impact.
